name: bunbird
description: Build small web apps with an AI agent, preview them live, and publish them in your Bunbird organisation, through one hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Build and publish small web apps
interface.longDescription: Bunbird is an agent-first platform for small web apps made for a group of people, with sign-in, data, files, live updates and background work provided by the platform. An agent reads the author's guide, builds a draft in one of the person's organisations, shows a live preview, and publishes it there. This package connects your agent to Bunbird's hosted MCP server; the server itself carries the guide and the flow.
defaultPrompt: Build me a small web app with Bunbird.
Show me a live preview of this app.
